kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أقتدر (form VIII)
# أَقْتَدِرُ (ʔaqtadiru) /ʔaq.ta.di.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَدَرَ (iqtadara)
# أَقْتَدِرَ (ʔaqtadira) /ʔaq.ta.di.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَدَرَ (iqtadara)
# أَقْتَدِرْ (ʔaqtadir) /ʔaq.ta.dir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِقْتَدَرَ (iqtadara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
